titel: How the Rich Manufacture Luck — And How YOU Can Too

einzeiler: How financial education and skill replace luck in building lasting wealth.
kurzfassung: Robert Kiyosaki argues that luck in investing is not a matter of random chance, but the result of preparation and financial intelligence. He shares his personal experience of losing nearly a million dollars and explains why lottery winners often end up broke without proper money management skills. Ultimately, he emphasizes that true financial success comes from learning the rules of the system and taking deliberate action instead of avoiding all risks.
stichpunkte: Luck in investing is defined as opportunity meeting preparedness rather than random fate.
Gambling in the markets is often disguised as professional investing when done without financial education.
Financial risk is relative and depends heavily on the investor's knowledge and preparation.
Lottery winners frequently lose their fortunes because they lack the underlying financial intelligence to protect wealth.
The financial system is intentionally designed by the wealthy, requiring individuals to learn its actual rules to succeed.
Avoiding all risks entirely prevents investors from ever encountering good fortune or positive returns.
Facing severe financial failure and taking responsibility leads to the most valuable business education.

kapitel.titel: The Danger of Playing It Safe

beschreibung: Robert Kiyosaki lost nearly $1,000,000 in one phone call — and it taught him how the rich actually MANUFACTURE luck instead of waiting for it. In this episode, Robert breaks down why "bad luck" is the wrong word for most financial disasters, why two lottery winners ended up broke and even in jail, and the one mental shift — L.U.C.K. — that separates people who build wealth from people who wait for it. If you've ever felt like luck happens to other people, this episode shows YOU how to build it yourself.
